summary: Six more launch checks read from your code, Apple's 15% program for apps that already sell, and real email checks.
notes: Six more launch rules read from your code, like a session recorder running unasked or marketing texts with no opt-out. Each shows only when your app does it.
iPhone apps that already sell get Apple's Paid Apps and Small Business Program cards: pay 15% instead of 30%. You answer it once for all your apps.
If your app sends email, launchpad checks your domain's email records for real and tells you exactly what's missing.
Mission Control counts app opens and screens for phone and Mac apps, and shows crashes from every Sentry project, one line each.
Big repos with shared folders no longer show extra websites, and an Android or Xcode app one folder deeper is found.

beta.summary: Every card shows one clear way to do it, and new versions arrive as a proper update window.
notes: Each to-do shows the quickest way first; other ways sit under one fold, each marked as an alternative.
A card launchpad can do itself says so, with one Do it button.
New versions open a window with the release notes and Update now, Later or Skip this version.
A newer update is never hidden behind an older notice.
Buys through a test checkout: you are not charged.
